title: A flower at bee size (AI scenery, real bees)
storyboard: Generate (AI, labelled): stylised bee-scale fly-through of a flower, no animals; bee shots stay real photos
caption:
AI scenery, real bees, clearly labelled.

Many flowers carry ultraviolet patterns invisible to us that guide bees toward nectar, while red flowers often look dark to them.
